SavedCase.title: SavedCase
SavedCase.description: A crime or violence case against a girl, teenager, or woman in India permanently archived ('Saved for Life') by a user, including State-District-City hierarchy and local MP/MLA accountability details.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who archived this case.

title.description: Headline of the incident or case dossier.

summary.description: Concise factual summary of the incident.

fullReport.description: Full investigative report and longitudinal case background.

stateName.description: Indian State or Union Territory where the incident occurred.

districtName.description: District within the state where the incident occurred.

cityName.description: City, town, or locality where the incident occurred.

mlaName.description: Name and constituency of the local MLA (Member of Legislative Assembly).

mpName.description: Name and constituency of the local MP (Member of Parliament).

victimCategory.description: Victim demographic category (e.g., Schoolgirl / Minor, Teenage Student, Woman).

crimeCategory.description: Category of violence or crime (e.g., School/Campus Attack, POCSO/Minor Assault, Domestic Violence).

caseStage.description: Current judicial/investigation stage (e.g., FIR_FILED, ACCUSED_ARRESTED, CHARGESHEET_FILED, TRIAL_ONGOING, VERDICT_DELIVERED, JUSTICE_PENDING).

personalNotes.description: Optional follow-up notes or accountability reminders added by the user.

imageUrl.description: Optional verified https:// photo URL for the incident so all users across devices can view it.

videoUrl.description: Optional verified https:// video report URL (MP4/HLS/broadcast) for the incident.

mediaCaption.description: Optional editorial caption and POCSO Section 23 compliance credit for attached media.

visibility.description: Visibility scope of the case record ('PRIVATE' for personal vault, 'PUBLIC' for shared dispatches).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the case was archived (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the case archive was last updated (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CaseFollowUp.title: CaseFollowUp
CaseFollowUp.description: A chronological follow-up update logged by an authenticated user in their personal archive to track progress on a saved case.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who logged this follow-up update.

caseId.description: ID of the tracked case dossier.

caseTitle.description: Title of the case dossier being updated.

stageBadge.description: Updated investigation or judicial stage badge.

details.description: Detailed factual description of the police, court, or MP/MLA action.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the follow-up was recorded (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the follow-up was last modified (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CorrectionRequest.title: CorrectionRequest
CorrectionRequest.description: A durable editorial correction, court-order link submission, or child/survivor privacy redaction request submitted by a user.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user submitting the correction or takedown request.

caseId.description: ID of the story or case dossier being flagged.

issueType.description: Category of issue (e.g., Factual Correction, Privacy / Minor Identity Protection, Updated Court / Police Order).

details.description: Description of the inaccuracy, privacy redaction request, or official primary source link.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the request was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the request was last updated.

/users/{userId}/saved_cases/{caseId}.description: Per-user private 'Save for Life' archive of crime dossiers and private notes.

/users/{userId}/case_updates/{updateId}.description: Per-user chronological follow-up notes tracking long-term outcomes for archived cases.

/users/{userId}/correction_requests/{req.description: Durable queue of user-submitted factual corrections and privacy/redaction requests.

/public_dispatches/{caseId}.description: Read-only server/editor-moderated public dispatches. Direct client writes are prohibited.
